== Description ==
'''SHA-180''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier. He is the infected counterpart of the removed entity [[D-180]].

== Behaviors ==
Upon spawning in, '''SHA-180''' will make a loud engine-like yell, before rushing forward extremely quickly, breaking down the door and slowly falling back behind the void wall. He rebounds a maximum of 4 times. Each rebound, he has a chance to summon either [[SHA-1]] or [[SHA-2]] due to his loud scream attracting them. After his last rebound, he will despawn upon contact with the door of the main room.

== Strategy & Tips ==

* '''SHA-180''' instantly rush to the main room at a very high speed when its spawn clue stops, so you should hide when the spawn sound stops.
* '''SHA-180''' rebounds to the front extremely quickly, but falls back a lot slower, so its best to stay in the most recent room as much as possible to avoid [[Claustrophobia]] from killing you.
* '''SHA-180''' has no locker-snipe, so it's okay to hide late but make sure you still pay attention to how loud he is when he approaches.
* Try to hide near many lockers when '''SHA-180''' is rebounding, as it can spawn [[SHA-1]]. This strategy will help you switch lockers quickly if your hiding spot is marked.
* When '''SHA-180''' breaks the door, stay in the locker for a bit longer in case [[SHA-2]] spawns. You could however, exit and reenter the locker to prevent [[Claustrophobia]] damage.

== Trivia ==

* '''SHA-180''' is one of the two shadow infected entities without a currently active uninfected counterpart, the other being [[SHA-7]].
* '''SHA-180''' is the 2nd fastest Shadow entity, only being behind [[SHA-85]].
* '''SHA-180''' is the only shadow infected entity that is not made more common in the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier. Instead, it was made way rarer.
** Because of this, '''SHA-180''' is not guaranteed to spawn in [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]].
** On the other hand, '''SHA-180''' is much more common in [[Shadow Challenge]].
* If you are unlucky enough, '''SHA-180''' can spawn [[SHA-200]], but he will wait until he despawns before actually rebounding again.
